field_map.selection: SELECTION HONESTY, restated per record set: cat 11 Weekly Carloads By 22 Commodity Categories (all railroads x 22 commodities — the volume spine), cat 1 Average Train Speed System only, cat 3 Cars On Line all car types. Terminal dwell, grain-car metrics, Chicago gateway and the rest of EP724 are deliberately NOT archived in v1 (workbook is public and re-pullable)

confidence_model: RAW carrier-reported EP724 filings, no derived quantities.
